command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Area 0.5 m², capacities per unit area 1 and 2, contact conductance per area 2. With s=i*omega, isolated cell and wall satisfy T+2Tw=(S+P)/s and Tw-T=(P/2-S)/(3+s). The common temperature pole coefficient is (S+P)/3. Compare it and both regular coefficients for cell temperature, surface temperature, conductive power, wall storage and wall energy balance for wall-only, body-only and proportional uniform heating. Additional checks cover a graded-capacity body and zero pole in an anchored plate.
